_spec: Violation brief for VIOL_cbav0001. CBA-framework violation arising from the same incident as VIOL_mc99v001 but under Brazilian domestic aviation law. Two violations from one incident is CORRECT when two different legal frameworks both apply — never collapse multi-framework violations into a single node.
allegation_summary: Carrier breached its contractual service obligation under CBA Art.175 §2 by refusing to provide alternative transport or any assistance to a passenger whose connection was missed due to operational delay, violating the service contract relationship established between carrier and passenger under Brazilian aviation law.

legal_basis.article_reference: CBA Title VI, Chapter I, Article 175 — Public Air Services Scope
legal_basis.relevant_excerpt: A relação jurídica entre o empresário e o usuário ou beneficiário dos serviços é contratual (§2) — the legal relationship between the carrier and the user is contractual.
legal_basis.nexus: CBA Art.175 §2 establishes that the carrier-passenger relationship is governed by contract. The carrier's refusal to provide any assistance directly breaches this contractual obligation. The standard of service under the contract includes providing alternative transport when the carrier causes the delay.

factual_basis.description: Carrier agent directed passenger to file a written complaint and offered no immediate assistance. No meal vouchers, accommodation, or rebooking was provided despite the carrier-caused delay.

grounding_segment.text: Passenger is informed to file a written complaint; assistance is not offered.
grounding_segment.speaker: airline_staff

articles_not_cited.reason: Art.260 covers baggage damage liability limits. The factual basis here (denial of rerouting and assistance) has no nexus to baggage. Precision rule §12.5: do NOT cite articles without direct factual nexus.

chaining_note: This violation was identified in the CBA framework stage, which ran with chaining_mode='all' (MC99 results in context). The chaining context allowed the CBA LLM to identify ACTN_noasst01 as an additional action distinct from ACTN_deny0001 — avoiding false duplication.

invariant_compliance.IX-1: PASS — ACTN_noasst01 has 1 incoming SUPPORTS_ACTION from EVID_trscr001
invariant_compliance.I-1: PASS — allegation only, no guilt or liability conclusion stated

related_violations.note: Both violations arise from the same interaction. VIOL_mc99v001 (MC99/delay liability) and VIOL_cbav0001 (CBA/service contract) are legally distinct — each requires its own factual nexus path.
